correctness.rationale: For every angular support direction conjugate the cyclic Hermitian part to a weighted real cycle with total phase n theta. Matching expansion gives D_k=q_n-(a^2+b^2-1)q_(n-2)+(a^2-1)(b^2-1)q_(k-2)q_(n-k-2)-2ab cos(n theta). Chebyshev recurrence implies D_(k+1)-D_k=Delta*q_(n-2k-2). A principal unit-weight path of n-k vertices bounds lambda_max(H_k) strictly above the largest zero of q_m, so q_m>0 above the edge. Root interlacing/sign of the determinant difference yields strict support-function ordering at every angle, uniform by angular compactness. Independent symbolic characteristic polynomials n=4,5,6 and numerical support eigenvalues n=6,8 corroborated; proof is all n.
